summary: The fractal-web conversation shows an empty loading body instead of the empty state while its first transcript snapshot is being published, groups a turn's reasoning into one Thinking disclosure, and fractal-ui gains a lightweight TranscriptSkeleton entry and an optional host-owned header

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui and apps/fractal-web change; no protocol, daemon, harness or CLI change. All kit additions are optional: Transcript accepts loadingState and showHeader (default true keeps the header), the package exports TranscriptSkeleton from the index and from the new @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui/transcript-skeleton entry, and EmbraceRuntime's adoption context adds isSnapshotAdopted. A turn's reasoning entries now share one Thinking disclosure in its work log. The Vite dev server's workspace watcher change affects development only.
